newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 rises for 11th session, sets record close.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 rises for 11th session, sets record close.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index finished at a record peak for the eight consecutive session on Tuesday, despite a wave of profit-taking on Wall Street.
The leading blue chip index, up for the eleventh straight session, added 21.4 points to close at 4,691.0, as advancers beat decliners by a margin of two to one.
The FTSE 100 leapt to an all-time peak at 4,720.3 early on, inspired by another strong performance on Wall Street overnight, but later slipped back as the Dow faltered.
